address.lineWithUnit: 8 North Sound Beach Avenue Extension Unit 1

remarks: Perfect location in Riverside, CT. 4 level end-unit with 3532 sq. feet of living space. This is a sophisticated & elegant townhouse that spares no expense in its features, and construction. Train is only a 5 minute drive as well as Binney Park. Tod's Point Beach is a short drive away, as well as the ferry to Island Beach. You are very close to schools, restaurants, golfing, shopping, & the Bruce Museum. A beautiful custom mahogany front door opens to a foyer that guides you to an open floor plan with rooms boasting 10 ft. ceilings. The gourmet kitchen has custom cabinets w/ an outstanding center island measuring approx. 6'8 by 4'8 that holds a wine cooler! Sliders from DR gives you easy access to a beautiful stone patio & private yard. Four large spacious bedrooms are found on the 2nd floor w/ with lots of closet space & a laundry room as well. Primary Bedroom has a beautiful, large ensuite bathroom w/ a spa like feel. The top-level room can function as an office/ playroom/recreation room or even as a 5th bedroom. The Lower Level is fully finished & heated with a full bath, offering an in-law/nanny suite option, and approx. 1500 additional square footage). Enjoy "single family" style living WITHOUT the expense of exterior maintenance & landscaping costs that usually accompany single family rentals. Unit freshly painted. Add'l exterior parking space in addition to 2 car garage. Schools are Dundee Elementary, Eastern Middle & Greenwich High. Some photos are from prior listing.
